experiment_data.hypothesis: Grid-b sweep b=0.1 on ρ=0.4 data, seed42. Minimal reweighting — expect PPL close to uniform (~17.694). Establishes lower bound of useful b range.
experiment_data.notes: PPL=17.657, between uniform(17.694) and b=0.3(17.640). b=0.1 provides minimal but positive improvement over uniform, consistent with near-uniform weighting at low b.
